descriptionChirho: Substantive participle used as a noun meaning 'one who does/works,' most commonly in the phrase 'workers of iniquity' (פֹּעֲלֵי אָוֶן).
General sense of doing, performing, or practicing an action, often referring to moral conduct or deeds (Arabic فعل, Spanish obrar, Korean 행하다).
Sense of making, fashioning, or creating something, including God as Maker/Creator (Arabic صنع, Spanish hacer/preparar, Korean 만들다, Swahili kuumba).
Sense of working or laboring at a task, emphasizing the effort of work rather than the action performed (Arabic عمل, Spanish trabajar, Korean 작업하다).
